correctness.rationale: A complete integer commutant parametrization yields an exact pointwise formula. The inequality C≥2HS+2S+1 forces the entire first band to have g=S=1, and an exact primitive-gcd equivalence follows. Möbius inversion gives the finite formula; uniform arithmetic-progression counts and absolutely convergent sum μ(r)/r³ give the O(H^-1) CDF with constant 1/(16ζ(3)). Boundary H≥1 and real 2≤z≤4 are covered. A separate exact-integer checker exhaustively validates 3107 pointwise cases and 35 threshold events; finite computations are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first band 2H–4H is forced structurally by the primitive commutant lattice parameter rather than arbitrarily selected. Its limiting probability 1/(4ζ(3)) is a substantial nonzero mass, with an exact finite formula for the entire band and a sharp quadratic lower-edge law. This refines known pointwise formulas and global first moments by describing an intrinsic distributional feature not obtainable from an aggregate pair count.
